friendly_name: Subtask skipped-status vocabulary in the diary contract
purpose_context: The CLI already writes 'skipped' subtask marks (spec-kitty#5953), but the shared events package only knows Lane values, so any consumer reading such a log raises ValueError. This mission adds a public subtask-status vocabulary with a terminal 'skipped' to the diary contract and ships it as a minor release, letting the CLI drop its local copy and consume the shared type.
purpose_tldr: Teach the diary contract the 'skipped' subtask value so logs with skipped subtasks parse instead of crashing consumers.
